Silver Nitrate Applicator Manufacturer in Türkiye

AGNAVELIS is a brand of Genco Tıbbi Cihazlar San. Tic. Ltd. Şti., a medical device manufacturer based in Bornova, İzmir, Türkiye. The company produces AGNAVELIS Silver Nitrate Applicator Sticks and is named as the legal manufacturer on the product label and in the Instructions for Use.

The company works with medical device distributors, hospital and clinic suppliers, healthcare wholesalers and importers. Product documentation is supplied in English and Turkish, and business enquiries are handled directly by the manufacturer rather than through an intermediary.

Manufacturing and Supply Approach

The points below describe how the manufacturer works with international buyers. Commercial terms, packaging configurations and market-specific documentation are confirmed individually for each enquiry.

Own production of the AGNAVELIS brand

AGNAVELIS is the manufacturer’s own brand. Silver nitrate applicator sticks are produced with the documented 75% silver nitrate and 25% potassium nitrate tip formulation on a rigid wooden shaft.

Manufacturer responsibility for the device

Genco Tıbbi Cihazlar San. Tic. Ltd. Şti. is the legal manufacturer stated on the label and in the Instructions for Use IFU-AGN-00, Rev. 00.

Export-oriented communication

Product documentation is prepared in English and Turkish so that importers and distributors can review the device in their own market review process.

Direct buyer contact

Distributor, wholesaler and importer enquiries are answered by the manufacturer, so technical and documentation questions reach the production source directly.

Product specification

Composition, shaft material, sterility and storage in one table.

Product documentation

Published documents and the documents available on request.

Contact and enquiries

WhatsApp, email and telephone details for B2B buyers.
